entries.zh: 瘫软颤动；瘫痪（风瘫之疾）
entries.en: to tremble; to be palsied, paralysed

entries.zh: 抖个不停；或嘴部随而发颤〔后半句残损〕
entries.en: to tremble a lot; or with the ... of the mouth (clause damaged)
entries.notes: 西文后半句 ʒa delarboc 残损难解，主义据 temblar mucho＝瘓瘓叠音定抖个不停义。

entries.zh: 吓得手脚发抖；因惧而手足颤动
entries.en: to tremble with fear, hands and feet shaking

entries.zh: 因病瘫颤；风瘫之症（瘫痪）
entries.en: to tremble from illness, as in palsy/paralysis
to shiver with cold

entries.zh: 冷得发抖；因寒而颤〔末字存疑〕
entries.en: to shiver with cold (as the previous entry; last character anomalous)
entries.notes: 末字「逐」与音写 chûn 不合，疑为「瘓」之别字或误录；义据西文同前条及重复句式。

entries.zh: 地动；地震〔原稿此条划删线〕
entries.en: the earth trembles; earthquake (struck through in manuscript)
entries.notes: 此条被删线划去，紧随之「地震」条圈出，似经修订替代；地动义据汉字与音写 rey tang 确定。

entries.en: earthquake; the earth to tremble, shake
to shake, quake; to tremble

entries.zh: 手乱颤；双手发抖〔末字未解〕
entries.en: to tremble with the hands; hands shaking in disorder
entries.notes: 末字「雲」音写 fy 与常规不合未能解；手抖义据西文 temblar las manos 与「手乱」定。

entries.en: to be startled, frightened; alarmed
to fear, be afraid of
entries.notes: M 栏末字残（尾字難辨）并夹西文 temer 字样；怕义据汉字与词头，不受尾部残损影响。

entries.en: to dread; to fear with misgiving
entries.notes: M 栏多项音写未能尽对且尾部残损（尾字難辨）；忌惮畏惧义据「忌」与 M 栏「畏」等推断。

entries.en: to fear, dread
to fear; terror, dread
to fear
entries.notes: 汉字「雲」与音写 fy 俱不合惧义，仅据西语词头 temer 及本页 temer 字群暂定惧怕义。

entries.zh: 惊愣失神；见物即惧〔释义存疑〕
entries.en: to be dazed with fright; to fear anything whatever (temer cualquier cosa)
entries.notes: 音写前三字 xoy/hay/goy 未能对字，「愣」本义发呆；据西文例句 temer cualquier cosa（见什么都怕）暂定，故降低置信。

entries.en: to palpitate; heart quivering with fear
to tremble with fear (as 觳觫); to be terrified
entries.notes: 「觳」取觳觫惧颤之义；音写 hai 亦近「駭」（惊骇）音。

entries.zh: 惮；畏惮、忌惮（有所畏而不敢为）
entries.en: to dread, shrink from; to fear

entries.zh: 戒惧；兢兢业业，惧而服从长上
entries.en: to stand in awe and obey one's superior; to be wary
entries.notes: 「業」取兢兢业业（畏惧貌）之义，配西文全句 temer y obedecera el superior（惧服长上）推断。
